first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A single person wearing a tight-fitting red-and-blue outfit with the head covered, gradually unfolding from a curled posture into a nearly vertical inverted posture above the Cluster of city buildings.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: Cloud cover with light and dark gray masses, covering a large area of the upper part of the image above the city.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: A dense collection of reddish-brown, gray, and dark-colored buildings on both sides and in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: A long, narrow gray road that passes between buildings from slightly left of center in the lower part of the image and converges into the distance.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: A collection of green and yellow-green tree canopies distributed along both sides of the road and between buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: Small light-colored and dark-colored vehicle outlines visibly distributed in groups on the road, retained as a background collection.

entities.name: Distant water surface
entities.identification: A broad gray-blue body of water behind the cluster of buildings on the left.

entities.name: Thin line pulled by the person
entities.identification: In the early portion, a dim, thin, narrow linear trace located to the right of Person A and extending diagonally into the upper-right sky; the source name does not indicate that a pulling function has been confirmed.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: A large horizontal purplish-red billboard on the exterior facade of the nearby reddish-brown building on the left.

entities.name: Group of orange-yellow vertical light strips
entities.identification: A collection of slender orange-yellow glowing strips appearing side by side above the roof of the nearby building on the left.

entities.name: Light-colored line below the person
entities.identification: Thin gray-white lines below Person A, overlaid on the central building surfaces; in frame 48, two line segments that gradually separate toward the bottom edge are discernible.
